nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Bạn bè · bài tự soạn
L: Hey Sam, are you free this Saturday?
I think so. Why? What's up?
A few of us are gonna try that new hotpot place near the river.
No way! I've been dying to go there.
Great. We're meeting at six. Wanna come along?
Sounds good. Should I bring anything?
Nah, just bring your appetite. The food's kinda spicy, though.
Even better. Text me the address, okay?
Sure. And don't be late this time!

exq.q: What does Jess invite Sam to do?
w: Go for a walk by the river

“We're meeting at six.” = gặp lúc sáu giờ.
